Risk levels for Zurich are a qualitative judgment call based on general knowledge and public reputation of each neighbourhood, not an official geolocated crime dataset — unlike London, no open municipal dataset at this level of detail exists yet for Zurich.
Real official data point: Oerlikon sits in Kreis 11, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average burglary rate of 5.47 per 1,000 residents there across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 54% of the 12-district average of 10.23/1,000. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for Oerlikon specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.
